blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Cariboo. No building list, strata fees, street boundaries or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Cariboo condos and townhomes in Burnaby: 23 listed at the end of October 2026 and 4 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 17%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. That makes Cariboo number 12 of 35 Burnaby communities by condo and townhome listings. Houses in Cariboo have their own page; this page is only about attached homes.

School District No. 41 (Burnaby), called SD41, bridges the two: its trustee zone for both is the single Cariboo Lougheed Zone, grouping École Cariboo Hill Secondaire with Armstrong, Second Street Community and Twelfth Avenue schools.

Brookside Park is the documented example of the stock's age: a four-storey wood-frame low-rise at 9620 Manchester Drive, strata plan NWS1579, 98 units, completed in 1982, per its management company's building data.

blocks.text: Cariboo Condos: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The rule hanging over the Manchester Drive cluster is the Lougheed Town Centre Plan: the City's rezoning notice for the neighbouring site states its Comprehensive Development (CD) district is based on the RM5s Multiple Family Residential District, the C3 General Commercial District, the Lougheed Core Area Master Plan and the Lougheed Town Centre Plan as guidelines.

Inside any Manchester Drive building, provincial strata law governs the purchase: the Form B Information Certificate states fees, amounts owing, approved special levies, the contingency reserve fund balance and an insurance summary, with the depreciation report attached.

blocks.text: Cariboo Condos: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Cariboo Hill Secondary School was built in 1961 and opened with 410 students, after Armstrong, Seaforth and Lyndhurst elementary schools filled the northeast Burnaby area it serves, per the City's heritage record.
Armstrong Elementary at 8757 Armstrong Avenue is the elementary school that shares the Cariboo-Armstrong name, one block from the secondary school.

The SD41 trustee zone name, Cariboo Lougheed, is the official hint that the district treats the Lougheed corridor and Cariboo Hill as one zone, which is why school paperwork for Manchester Drive uses the Cariboo name at all.
Cariboo Hill School Park at 8670 16th Avenue adjoins the secondary school in southeast Burnaby — a park carrying the Cariboo name that has nothing to do with the Manchester Drive condos.
The City's rezoning map for Reference #24-23 labels Manchester Drive, Morrey Court and Cariboo Road together, placing the condo cluster inside the Lougheed Town Centre plan's street grid.

blocks.text: Cariboo Condos: development and new projects

items.t: Developer or applicant name: not stated in the City notice read. Status: public notice mailed April 8, 2026 for first and second reading at the April 28, 2026 Council meeting (as of November 3, 2026).
BC Property Transfer Tax (PTT) applies at 1% on the first $200,000, 2% from $200,000 to $2 million and 3% above $2 million on a Cariboo condo purchase, with exemptions stated on the Province's page.

Lougheed Town Centre Station, on the Millennium Line, is the SkyTrain station for the Manchester Drive cluster, shown with Cariboo Road and the Lougheed Highway corridor on TransLink's Burnaby system map.
Routes 110 and 136 both work the Government Road and Lougheed corridor beside the cluster on the same TransLink map, with the 136 running between Lougheed Station and Brentwood Station.

blocks.text: Cariboo Condos: risks and due diligence

items.t: Start with building age and construction: Brookside Park is 1982 wood-frame construction, so the depreciation report's building envelope, roof and plumbing timelines are the purchase risk, not the unit's finishes.

faq.q: How many condos are for sale in Cariboo?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 23 condos and townhomes listed in Cariboo. That is a month-end count and moves daily; ask Jared for what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Cariboo a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos?
faq.a: With a sales ratio of 17% in October 2026, condos and townhomes in Cariboo sat in a balanced market. The reports read under 12% as a buyers’ market and over 20% as a sellers’ market.

faq.q: How many condos sold in Cariboo from June to October 2026?
faq.a: Cariboo accounted for 11 of the 916 condos and townhomes sold across Burnaby from June to October 2026.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so any count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
